overview.description: The State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLSI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Consumer Staples Select Sector index. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-fund that holds the Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLP). It aims to provide additional income through selling short-dated listed call options. XLSI was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
